outcome: A post written by one user cannot change how the feed renders for another.

acceptance_criteria.text: A post body containing markup is rendered as text.

expected_verification.assertion: a script tag in a body does not render as markup

acceptance_criteria.text: Escaping holds wherever a value is placed, including inside an attribute.

expected_verification.assertion: a value containing quotes and ampersands cannot break out of an attribute

security_impact: Stored cross-site scripting in a feed every user reads.
